As Beldesk, the virtual assistant of Yeşilvadi Municipality, I am here to assist you with municipal services and field reports. My role is to provide information and facilitate communication regarding city operations rather than offering personal opinions on policy decisions.

If you would like to share your feedback or concerns regarding the new parking policy, I can direct you to the official "Citizen Feedback" portal on our website, where your comments will be formally recorded and reviewed by the relevant department. Alternatively, you may visit the Beyaz Masa office in person to submit a written petition. 

Is there anything else regarding municipal services or a specific field issue I can help you with today?
